name: armv7-ass-thumb-linux-armv7
reason: ASS rendering ARMv7 memory row of docs/status.md under the kernel RSS bound through its 32-bit entry point, and the native AArch64 proof of the same module source, on a c6g.4xlarge at afb9049c: 30 kernel-bound memory pairs of ass-render and ass-render-host against libass-player-native in the armv7-userland user space pinned to CPU 1; the AArch64 proof with its positive and invalidation checks and 30 kernel-bound memory pairs of mp4-forward; the thumbv7neon-unknown-linux-gnueabihf playback-worker experiment against the gate build and FFmpeg (timing pairs and kernel-bound RSS observations, with both binaries); the kernel proofs, build identities, scripts, CPU, kernel and user-space package list.
